title: NOMOS GX402 HCS Anchor Envelope v2
description: The exact message body submitted to a Hedera Consensus Service topic. Digests and identifiers only — never receipt content, keys, paths or personal data.

network.description: Pinned to Hedera testnet. Mainnet documents are unrepresentable by construction.

record_digest.description: The anchored value. MUST equal the receipt's record_digest.

digest_algorithm.description: Hash function behind record_digest. The value itself is `sha256:<64 lowercase hex>`.

canonicalization.description: Profile under which record_digest is reproducible. Without it the digest is unverifiable.

receipt_schema_version.description: Which receipt schema the anchored digest was computed under.

source_transaction_id.description: The Hedera payment the receipt attests. Lets a topic reader reach the payment.

created_at.description: When the envelope was built. NOT the consensus time — that is assigned by the network.

purpose.description: Fixed literal. A free-text purpose would be a content channel.

env.description: Machine-readable honesty flag: anyone reading the topic sees this is a testnet demo.
